title: Vanished Assignment
description: A dispatcher tries to remove a scheduling card that's already gone — maybe two dispatchers clicked delete on the same card at once. The second delete shouldn't succeed silently.
successCondition: Create an assignment, note its id, DELETE /api/fleet/assignments/:id once (returns 204), then DELETE the exact same id again — the second call returns 404 with error.code NOT_FOUND.
hints: The assignment's own id (not the shipmentId used to create it) is what the delete route takes as its path param — capture it from the PUT response's assignment.id field.
GET /api/fleet/assignments after the first delete is a good sanity check that the assignment is really gone before you attempt the second delete.
